Enum Class ContributorRequirement

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ContributorRequirement>
testingAutomation.ContributorRequirement
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ContributorRequirement>, Constable
public enum ContributorRequirement extends Enum<ContributorRequirement>

Title: ContributorRequirement Enumeration.

Description: The single list of every TP2 Contributor (Phase Two) requirement, with its owner, its source in the "Lessons Learned System V1 2026-08-19" user stories (C1 to C4 are the four Contributor Phase Two stories in order), the teammates' tests that also cover it, and a manual test procedure. This is the Task 6 requirements-to-tests list in code form: each constant is mapped to two or more tests in ContributorRequirementsTestbed, at least one positive and one negative, through the RequirementTest annotation.

Owners follow the TP2 Work Split: Vishwam Gupta (lesson entity, experience data, persistence, validation), Kanish Garg (Contributor lesson and experience GUI), Joshua Luther (lesson list class, search, list GUI), and Aditya Gupta agupt515 (requirements coverage, integration, testing).

    Description
    CR01
    C1: a Contributor adds a lesson by entering its core information.
    CR02
    C1 and TP2 input validation: invalid core information is refused.
    CR03
    C1: a Contributor can see and manage (update) a lesson they added.
    CR04
    C1/C2: other roles may lock fields so the Contributor cannot alter them.
    CR05
    C1/C2: a whole-lesson lock prevents all Contributor changes.

    C1 and the TP1 destructive-action UX rule: deletion needs an explicit Yes.
    CR07
    C2: a lesson with any lock cannot be deleted.
    CR08
    C1: the Contributor cannot see or alter information added by other roles.
    CR09
    C2/C4: the Contributor's list holds exactly their own lessons.
    CR10
    C2: examining a lesson shows which fields are locked.

    C2 list use and the work split's keyword-search subset.

    C1-C4 with the Foundations session rules.
